findings.message: 7 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: 28 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "DAVAO DEL NORTE STATE COLLEGE · 2026", "Domain", "Locale", "Approach").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 4 gradient fill(s): div.lp-map-card → linear-gradient(160deg, rgb(244, 241, 234) 0%, rgb(235, 230, 220) 100%) | div.sdg-card.sdg-11 → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(253, 157, 36) 0%, rgb(217, 119, 6) 100%) | div.sdg-card.sdg-15 → linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(86, 192, 43) 0%, rgb(47, 122, 22) 100%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 3 typefaces in use (Geist, Geist Mono, Fraunces).
This page is served by a development server (Vite, webpack or Next in dev mode).
findings.fix: Run the last gate on the production build too (vite build && vite preview, next build && next start, or the built index.html): minifiers and bundlers change the CSS a visitor receives.

findings.message: The sheet dealt IBM Plex Sans, but the page renders Geist, Geist Mono.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: 2 panel shadow(s) heavy enough to read as floating: rgba(20, 40, 30, 0.18) 0px 30px 60px -30px | rgba(20, 40, 30, 0.35) 0px 30px 60px -30px
findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.
One hue for the series that matters, a neutral for the rest, and at most four series colours in total; status colours only for status.

findings.message: 3 text blocks under 11px: Panabo City 10px, TOP BARANGAY · COMMERCIA 10px, ⚠ ENV FLAGS · 10px.
Only 3 of 10 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.

findings.message: 2 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 72px in "What the citizen sees.", 51px in "What the city owns.".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.
An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).
Figures run 16-40px on app screens; none of the studied screens reaches 48px. Size and isolation make a number loud, not display type.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "A three-tier architecture for spatial decisions." → 3 lines (6 words, 36px); "Two Sustainable Development Goals, one decision " → 3 lines (7 words, 36px); "Open the system and explore your first barangay." → 6 lines (8 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Where people live" (screen 5, 100% hidden); "2,877 ha 10.9% of the city" (screen 5, 100% hidden); "Every zone, one answer away" (screen 7, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
